wallet.title: My wallet
wallet.subtitle: Your digital compensation hub — outlook, bonuses, and payroll in one place.

hero.earnedHint: Released bonuses and payroll queue — not a bank balance.
hero.nextRemainingHint: Remaining on your open salary line this cycle.
hero.nextTotalHint: Total payable on your upcoming salary line.
hero.readOnly: Read-only compensation view — not a bank account.

overview.pipelineHint: How your bonus entries split across stages — tap Bonuses for full detail.

pipeline.explainPotential: Not earned yet — usually waits on client payment, project delivery, or eligibility rules.
pipeline.explainInProgress: Accrued or waiting on conditions (product done, KPI gate, pool funding). Not in payroll yet.
pipeline.explainNextPayroll: Release approved or on an open payroll run — payout follows Finance payroll and Pay Now.
pipeline.explainPaid: Marked paid on a payroll release. Remaining on the entry may still show timing differences.
pipeline.explainCorrections: Clawback or correction entry — reduced or reversed bonus; Finance can explain details.
pipeline.empty: No bonus pipeline entries yet — amounts appear when orders and releases are linked to you.

payout.explainUnpaid: No paid releases on your entries for this order yet.
payout.explainPartial: Some of your bonus on this order was paid; the rest is still open or waiting on funding.
payout.explainPaid: Your paid releases on this order match the planned payout for this scope.

glossary.title: How to read this wallet
glossary.intro: Amounts are planned compensation from NBOS, not your bank balance. Tap a payroll month for detail.
glossary.partialPayText: Salary or bonus was paid in one or more steps. Remaining is still on the payroll line or bonus entry.
glossary.delayedText: Bonus stays in Potential or In progress until the product pool is funded or KPI/eligibility passes.
glossary.paidText: Release amount was included in payroll and recorded as paid on the expense card.
glossary.clawbackText: Bonus reversed or adjusted downward — shown under Corrections in the pipeline.
glossary.burnedText: Sales KPI may reduce payout at attach (burned). Monthly bonus cap (200% of base salary, default) defers excess; prior-month carry-over applies automatically when you attach bonuses in a later month.
glossary.carryOverText: Unpaid release balance moved to a later payroll month. Tracking in wallet will follow policy engine rollout.

bonus.title: Bonus pipeline
bonus.subscription: Subscription order — bonus releases may follow client invoice payments.
bonus.clawback: Clawback — this bonus was reversed or reduced. Check Corrections or ask Finance.
bonus.paidTiming: Marked paid; a small remaining amount may reflect timing between release and entry totals.
bonus.paid: Paid through payroll — releases on this entry are recorded as paid.
bonus.pendingEligibility: Waiting on eligibility (e.g. product delivered, KPI, or funding) before payroll release.
bonus.potential: Potential accrual — bonus grows with client payments or project progress, not paid yet.
bonus.partial: Partially paid — part went through payroll; the rest is still planned or awaiting release.
bonus.kpiBurnedAmount: Sales KPI reduced payroll by {amount} on a prior attach — see included vs released amounts.
bonus.includedInPayroll: Included in payroll {month} — payout when Finance records expense payments.
bonus.releasedUnpaid: Released to payroll but not paid yet — follows Pay Now / expense payment timing.
bonus.carryOverHint: {amount} deferred to a later payroll month — monthly bonus cap was reached at attach.
bonus.queued: Queued for payroll — amount may change if KPI or funding rules apply at attach.
bonus.salesInProgress: Sales bonus — payout may depend on KPI when the release is attached to payroll.

projects.title: Project breakdown
projects.hint: Per-order roll-up with product pool funding (read-only). Payout column explains unpaid, partial, or paid bonus on your entries.

payroll.salaryByMonthHint: Accumulating, active payout, and paid — open any month for the full breakdown.
payroll.emptyMonths: No payroll months on your record yet.
payroll.phaseActiveHint: Prior month approved — pay via expense card (typically 1–15).
payroll.phaseAccumulatingHint: Current or future month — bonuses and salary still building.
payroll.phasePaidHint: Salary line fully paid through expense payments.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.hint: Latest payroll and bonus events tied to you (read-only).

forecast.title: Bonus outlook
forecast.hint: Planned amounts from your bonus entries — not cash in bank. Incoming depends on client payments and eligibility; earned path follows releases and payroll.
forecast.openPayroll: Open payroll month includes {amount} on your salary line (may differ from per-entry totals when KPI applies).
